manifests.title: Parent-function gallery

manifests.learnerOutcome: Recognize benchmark function families by domain, range, symmetry, intercepts, end behavior, and rate patterns.

manifests.title: Input-output machine

manifests.title: Vertical point mapping

manifests.title: Feature ledger

manifests.title: Input relocation

manifests.title: Domain interval translation

manifests.title: Axis reflection mappings

manifests.title: Even-odd-neither gallery

manifests.learnerOutcome: Reflect function graphs across coordinate axes and connect reflection rules with even and odd symmetry.
